title: Transit fares with transfers, service-day caps and end-of-day refunds
why_hard: Order of application decides the total. The refund of ride 27 comes only after its service day, which includes ride 29 at 03:20 on Thursday, so ride 28 stays capped at 0. In week 1 the refunded 320 stops counting toward the weekly cap, so later rides fill the cap again. Rides 14 and 29 are charged 0 by caps but still start journeys, so rides 15 and 30 are transfers across a service-day or service-week boundary. The 90-minute window runs from the journey's first ride and is inclusive (ride 17), with at most 2 transfers (ride 24). Upgrades are priced with the first ride's peak status (ride 17). The cheaper-of-two discount gives 210 rather than 220 for off-peak 2-zone rides.
